findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "research" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: stockexpertai_get_stock_summary · Public sink: stockexpertai_get_stock_summary.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: stockexpertai_get_stock_summary · Public sink: stockexpertai_get_stock_summary

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
